coder_notes: Malignant glioma (WHO grade II or IV) with no explicit glioblastoma mention in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm label. 5-ALA is used only for fluorescence visualisation during resection; the registered intervention is a diagnostic test (exoscope filter) and the 5-ALA row is listed for transparency.
